findings: The 70-case canonical surface is generated from PHASE9_FAULT_CASES rather than a source-derived reachable failure-exit inventory.
The materialized call graph contains broad steps rather than exact function/class call edges and per-exit semantics.
The static audit does not close registry, models, HTTP, Contract Runtime, workflows, and tasks against every reachable exit.
Phase 9 per-case PASS assertions do not consume case-specific typed failure, durable receipt, dispatch, authority, restart, and recovery evidence.
Multiple cases share proxy tests or inaccurate source bindings, so one-to-one real-boundary injection is not established.
